retirements.evidence: Pure Core scoring has no service argument, no GTK getter, provider session, storage, I/O or rights check; synthetic headless tests assert original-language bonus, missing identity returns zero and a facade getter is invoked once per score. Preference values cannot grant a source action or entitlement.

retirements.original: core.provider_sessions._opening_sync_covers_visible_accounts read the mutable current_identity getter during the startup connect sweep to choose which borrower's loans could be suppressed
retirements.replacement: The startup connection sweep passes an exact admitted account/identity scope; the Core worker accepts only explicit selected_identity_id and refuses missing, malformed or accountless scope or indeterminate source Sync consent, instead of re-reading GUI selection.
retirements.evidence: Synthetic headless service with poison-current_identity proves no worker navigation read; unknown/malformed scope and absent accounts preserve forced refresh; explicit switched profiles and non-affirmative Sync policy never suppress the initial loan read. No supplier GET, consent update, acquisition, SQLite writes or new supplier switch.

retirements.original: core.provider_sessions._provider_enabled_for_identity inferred the active GTK-selected profile (and default fallback) when applying virtual/public provider enabled_for_identity and per-identity overrides; selected_private_offer_hint invoked this policy without passing its already admitted source identity
retirements.replacement: Core provider enablement requires a well-formed explicit identity for public/virtual visibility before reading plugin manager policy. The historical LibraryService no-argument method captures selection once at the synchronous facade boundary; selected_private_offer_hint always supplies the scoped identity and refuses missing scope before enablement.
retirements.evidence: Synthetic headless Core worker has poison current_identity and checks exact Alice/Bob enablement; malformed/missing/foreign identities refuse before manager queries. The facade getter runs once only for no-argument legacy callers; explicitly scoped private-offer hint cannot inherit another GTK identity and makes no provider calls. Non-virtual ready session behavior is unchanged.

retirements.original: core.source_materialization._source restricted a generic manual confirmation to account.provider_id == 'kobo', imported a Kobo-only backup root selector and included obsolete kobo_backup policy/directory settings in the one-use canonical A-to-B fingerprint
retirements.replacement: Admission now uses the provider-declared local_materialization capability plus backup support and exact source/account/session/canonical consent checks, with Core-neutral canonical library/profile roots. A provider-owned versioned primary-account identity label is the only accepted legacy owner alias; missing declaration fails closed. No W2 backup writer can execute.
retirements.evidence: Exact connected source and storage identity binding still mandatory, duplicate borrower and stale session refused, no implicit GTK selection; full canonical delivery ABI + on-policy required to issue token, one-use confirmation revalidates provider epoch, source epoch, consent and A snapshot, then calls a single canonical Source Sync. Synthetic future provider with local_materialization capability uses the read-only preflight, backup-only provider cannot; no branded source checks or legacy backup roots in shared Core.
